title: Engram authority/store transition: a failed revoke plus a failed shared Codex detach can leave a previously issued MCP capability usable
outcome: Every Engram authority or store transition either invalidates or contains previously issued MCP capabilities, or durably records an Unknown partial outcome with supported recovery. A failed revoke combined with a failed shared-runtime detach never silently leaves an old capability usable.
acceptance: A design ruling records how the authority owner invalidates or contains issued capabilities across a store/authority transition when revoke or detach fails, including durable Unknown/partial-outcome recovery, with file:line.

Deterministic tests cover failed revoke combined with failed detach, and show the old capability cannot be used afterwards, or the outcome is durably recorded as Unknown with supported recovery; successful-rotation behaviour is unchanged.
